Asp.name: Asp
Asp.effect: Destroys a single random program installed on the target netrunner's cyberdeck.

Giant.name: Giant
Giant.effect: Does 3d6 damage directly to the target netrunner's brain. They are forcibly and unsafely jacked out of the NET architecture, suffering any consequences (except Giant).

Hellhound.name: Hellhound
Hellhound.effect: Does 2d6 damage directly to the target netrunner's brain. Unless insulated, their cyberdeck catches fire along with their clothing. Until they spend a meat action to put themselves out, they take 2 damage directly to their HP whenever they end their turn. This effect does not stack.

Kraken.name: Kraken
Kraken.effect: Does 3d6 damage directly to the target netrunner's brain. Until the end of their next turn, the target netrunner cannot progress deeper into the NET architecture, or jack out safely. They can still jack out unsafely, though.

Liche.name: Liche
Liche.effect: Target netrunner's INT, REF, and DEX are all lowered by 1d6 (minimum 1). The effect is largely psychosomatic and wears off after one hour.

Raven.name: Raven
Raven.effect: Derezzes a single random defender program which the target netrunner has rezzed, and deals 1d6 damage directly to their brain.

Scorpion.name: Scorpion
Scorpion.effect: Target netrunner's MOVE is lowered by 1d6 (minimum 1). The effect is largely psychosomatic and wears off after one hour.

Skunk.name: Skunk
Skunk.effect: Until this program is derezzed, the target netrunner has -2 to all slide checks. Skunk can only affect a single netrunner, but the effects of multiple skunks can stack.

Wisp.name: Wisp
Wisp.effect: Does 1d6 damage directly to the target netrunner's brain, and lowers the number of NET actions they can take on their next turn by 1 (minimum 2).

Armor.name: Armor
Armor.effect: Lowers any brain damage you would receive by 4.

Flak.name: Flak
Flak.effect: Reduces the ATK of non-Black ICE programs to 0.

Shield.name: Shield
Shield.effect: Automatically derezzed to stop you from taking brain damage from one non-Black ICE program.

Banhammer.name: Banhammer
Banhammer.effect: 2d6 damage to a Black ICE program, or 3d6 to a non-Black ICE program.

Sword.name: Sword
Sword.effect: 3d6 damage to a Black ICE program, or 2d6 to a non-Black ICE program.

DeckKrash.name: Deck KRASH
DeckKrash.effect: Target netrunner is forcibly and unsafely jacked out.

Hellbolt.name: Hellbolt
Hellbolt.effect: 2d6 damage directly to the brain; unless insulated the cyberdeck catches fire — 2 HP per turn until extinguished with a meat action (does not stack).

Nervescrub.name: Nervescrub
Nervescrub.effect: Target's INT, REF and DEX lowered by 1d6 (min 1), psychosomatic, wears off in an hour.

PoisonFlatline.name: Poison Flatline
PoisonFlatline.effect: Destroys a single random non-Black ICE program on the target's cyberdeck.

Superglue.name: Superglue
Superglue.effect: Target cannot go deeper or jack out safely for 1d6 rounds (unsafe jack-out allowed); each copy rezzes once per netrun.

Vrizzbolt.name: Vrizzbolt
Vrizzbolt.effect: 1d6 direct brain damage and -1 NET action next turn (min 2).

Equipment.Title: Equipment reference

backupDrive.name: Backup Drive
backupDrive.effect: 2 slots. Saves destroyed non-Black ICE programs. One Meat Action reinstalls saved programs if slots suffice, preserving their spent once-per-run state. Uninstalling the drive erases its contents.

dnaLock.name: DNA Lock
dnaLock.effect: 2 slots. A locked deck requires its biometric key or a DV17 Electronics/Security Tech check to access.

hardenedCircuitry.name: Hardened Circuitry
hardenedCircuitry.effect: 1 slot. EMP and non-Black ICE program effects cannot disable, render inoperable or destroy the deck.

insulatedWiring.name: Insulated Wiring
insulatedWiring.effect: 1 slot. Program effects cannot ignite the deck or the user's clothing.

krashBarrier.name: KRASH Barrier
krashBarrier.effect: 2 slots. Immune to program effects that force a safe or unsafe Jack Out; does not prevent disconnection from other causes.

rangeUpgrade.name: Range Upgrade
rangeUpgrade.effect: 1 slot. Connection range becomes 8 m from an access point.

kiramaAdvanced.name: Kirama Advanced Deck
kiramaAdvanced.effect: 5 shared slots. Treat every unsafe Jack Out as safe.

kiramaEntry.name: Kirama Entry Deck
kiramaEntry.effect: 5 Program-only slots; at most one each of Attacker, Defender, Booster and Black ICE. Treat unsafe Jack Out as safe.

kiramaTraining.name: Kirama Training Deck
kiramaTraining.effect: 5 Program-only slots. Stay within 2 m of the access point. All direct brain damage is doubled.

microtechAssault.name: Microtech Assault
microtechAssault.effect: 4 Black ICE-only Program slots and 5 Hardware-only slots.

microtechScout.name: Microtech Scout
microtechScout.effect: 5 shared slots. Immediately after Jack In, use Pathfinder once without spending a NET Action.

microtechWarrior.name: Microtech Warrior
microtechWarrior.effect: 7 Program-only slots. Immediately after Jack In, activate one installed Armor without a NET Action.

hummingbird.name: Raven Microcyb Hummingbird
hummingbird.effect: 2 Hardware-only slots. Gain +1 NET Action each turn.

kestrel2.name: Raven Microsyb Kestrel 2
kestrel2.effect: 7 Program-only slots. Immediately after Jack In, activate up to two installed Speedy Gonzalves without a NET Action.

phoenix.name: Raven Microcyb Phoenix
phoenix.effect: 6 shared slots. Safe Jack Out restores all programs destroyed on this deck during the run.

kerberos.name: SGI Technologies Kerberos
kerberos.effect: 6 Hellhound-only Program slots and 5 Hardware-only slots.

verdantKnight.name: SGI Technologies Verdant Knight
verdantKnight.effect: 9 Program-only slots; only Sword and Shield may be installed.

warlocksBook.name: SGI Technologies Warlock's Book
warlocksBook.effect: 9 shared slots. No Attacker or Black ICE programs may be installed.

kaliya.name: Zetatech Kaliya
kaliya.effect: 3 Flak-only slots plus 6 shared slots. The only permitted Defender is Flak; the only permitted Black ICE is Asp.

microMate.name: Zetatech MicroMate
microMate.effect: 9 shared slots. No Defenders. All direct brain damage is doubled.

aerie.name: Aerie
aerie.effect: 2 slots. Installed Raven attacks destroy a random active enemy Defender instead of derezzing it.

bushidoAccelerator.name: Bushido Accelerator
bushidoAccelerator.effect: 3 slots per description (p.5; table on p.7 says 2). Each installed unit grants all installed Killer Black ICE +2 SPD.

combatRecorder.name: Combat Recorder
combatRecorder.effect: 1 slot. Another netrunner's failed Death Save in your NET Architecture saves an anonymized five-minute recording, typically worth 50eb.

defenseSequencer.name: Defense Sequencer
defenseSequencer.effect: 2 slots. When active Armor is derezzed or destroyed, automatically activate an installed Armor not yet used this run at the start of your next turn, for no NET Action.

felineInstinct.name: Feline Instinct
felineInstinct.effect: 2 slots. Each program destroyed by an installed Sabertooth adds +1d6 to that Sabertooth's damage until Jack Out.

hangryHangryDragon.name: Hangry Hangry Dragon
hangryHangryDragon.effect: 1 slot. An installed Dragon restores its REZ to maximum whenever it destroys a program.

perfumeShoppe.name: Perfume Shoppe
perfumeShoppe.effect: 2 slots. Installed Skunk Black ICE costs 1 Program slot rather than 2.

smithy.name: Smithy
smithy.effect: 1 slot. One Meat Action simultaneously converts ALL installed Sword programs to Banhammer and ALL installed Banhammer programs to Sword.

snaketrap.name: Snaketrap
snaketrap.effect: 1 slot. Once per run prevents the first Black ICE/program effect that would destroy a random installed program. Multiple copies do not add uses.

swampMist.name: Swamp Mist
swampMist.effect: 2 slots. Installed Wisp deals 2d6 instead of 1d6. No Black ICE other than Wisp may be installed.

swiftyClean.name: Swifty Clean
swiftyClean.effect: 2 slots. Cloak rolls twice for one NET Action and keeps the higher total, but Cloak can only be used once per run.

bodyweightSuit.name: Bodyweight Suit
bodyweightSuit.effect: Worn head/body SP11 armor. Houses a deck and adds one Hardware-only slot.

cyberdeckCyberarmOption.name: Cyberdeck Cyberarm Option
cyberdeckCyberarmOption.effect: Cyberarm-installed deck gains one shared Program/Hardware slot. The deck's Program restrictions still apply.

integratedCyberdeckUpgrade.name: Integrated Cyberdeck Upgrade
integratedCyberdeckUpgrade.effect: Adds one shared slot to a Cyberarm-integrated deck on the SAME Cyberarm only.

lotosNetsuit.name: Lotos Netsuit
lotosNetsuit.effect: One external Hardware-only slot; its hardware uninstalls on removal. Head and body SP13, REF/DEX/MOVE -2. Cannot combine with Bodyweight Suit or similar armor/fashion. Includes an excellent deck.

cyberConductor.name: Zetatech CyberConductor
cyberConductor.effect: Holds up to 3 decks. While jacked in, one Meat Action switches decks, derezzes ALL active programs including Black ICE, then deals 3 direct HP damage. Decks never share programs/hardware. Installing a deck takes 1 hour.

integratedCyberConductor.name: Zetatech CyberConductor, Integrated
integratedCyberConductor.effect: FBC-only Borgware, 3 Internal Body slots, maximum one. Also connects decks installed as cyberware in the FBC. Same switching rules but no HP damage; contained decks count as cyberware-integrated.

rockLobster.name: Rock Lobster
rockLobster.effect: CrAB Lord's unique Balron: REZ30, Interface7, 4 NET Actions, Combat Number14. Can perform any NET Action a netrunner can. Not a fourth standard Demon and never automatically installed.

Equipment.None: No recognized equipment installed on this deck.
Equipment.Meat: Hardware actions labelled Meat Action replace all NET Actions for this turn. Range and biometric checks require a physical access point and GM adjudication.
Equipment.RestrictedSwap: The deck does not allow the resulting Smithy programs.
Equipment.NoConductorDeck: Both decks must be connected to the same CyberConductor.
Equipment.SwiftyUsed: Swifty Clean allows Cloak only once per Netrun.
Equipment.DeckDisabled: The deck is disabled. The GM can clear this condition.
Equipment.InvalidLoadout: The installed programs/hardware violate this deck’s slot or class restrictions.

Effects.forceJackOut: Force unsafe Jack Out (Giant / Deck KRASH)
Effects.randomNonIce: Destroy a random non-Black ICE program (Poison Flatline)
Effects.raven: Derez a random active Defender (Raven / Aerie)

Equipment.RecordingSaved: Combat Recorder saved an anonymized 5-minute recording (typical value 50 eb). No money was added.

fbcBodyweightCoating.name: FBC Integrated Bodyweight Coating
fbcBodyweightCoating.effect: FBC-only external cyberware. Each installation adds 2 shared Hardware-only slots benefiting all cyberware-integrated decks, which no longer need Interface Plugs. Cannot benefit from a Bodyweight Suit.

functionDriver.name: Function Driver
functionDriver.effect: Invented upgrade installed on a deck. One selected 1-slot non-Black ICE program takes no slot and cannot be destroyed by Program effects; it can still be derezzed.

netsuitInsulation.name: Netsuit Insulation
netsuitInsulation.effect: Invented upgrade installed on Bodyweight Suit or similar worn armor. Grants Insulated Wiring without using its Hardware-only slot.

superSlide.name: Super Slide
superSlide.effect: Invented upgrade to Speedy Gonzalvez or Worm. While that upgraded program is active, permits two Slide attempts per turn.

crunchWhistle.name: Crunch Whistle
crunchWhistle.effect: 1 slot. Connects the cyberdeck to a Breacher. Add Interface Rank to Electronics/Security Tech checks made to hack Agents; requires that specific setup and task.
